cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,random,string
sys.path.insert(0,'submission');import gateway
random.seed(1)
chars=string.ascii_letters+string.digits+' :;,<>"\\\r\n\t@.+-_%()!*\'`~'
errs=0; oks=0
for i in range(200000):
 n=random.randrange(0,150)
 s=''.join(random.choice(chars) for _ in range(n))
 try:
  gateway._parse_request(s); oks+=1
 except gateway.SIPFailure:
  pass
 except Exception as e:
  errs+=1
  print('EXC',type(e).__name__,repr(s)); break
print('done errs',errs,'oks',oks)
PY
